text.text: The supreme great blade is the station's full form: two blades, two handles and two saya, all six parts on the bench and every number stacked.

Each pair is added separately. Durability = (both blades + both saya) durability × 1.2 (great blade factor) × (1 + both handle durability modifiers); attack = (both blades + both saya) attack × (1 + both handle attack modifiers) + 1; mining speed = (both blades + both saya) mining speed × (1 + both handle mining modifiers), mining level taken from the best of the six; attack speed = 1.6 × (1 + both handle speed modifiers). All six parts may be different materials.
Handle modifiers follow Tinkers' own percentage semantics: -25% means ×0.75, and the two handles' modifiers are added separately - they may cancel each other out or stack very high.
Colour, slash art, texture and repair material follow the main blade; the second blade's trait counts at 75%, both handles and both saya at 50% each.
A great blade blank can also be forged directly at the blade forge - pick Supreme Great Blade in its recipe list - but that is only a down payment: filling all six slots is the real thing.
